After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Siege of Zygerria|besieged]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]], Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], assisted by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bannidge Holt]], conducted a series of '''raids''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tervissis]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. Yularen's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], consisting of [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruisers]] and [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], served as a base of operations for the raids. The raids were part of the [[Listehol Campaign]], in which Imperial forces attempted to drive [[Tervig]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], along with [[Zygerrian Slavers Guild|Zygerrian slavers]] and [[Sikurdian/Legends|Sikurdian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], from the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] known as the [[Listehol Run/Legends|Listehol Run]] and the [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]]. However, Tervissis was intractable, and resisted the Imperial raids. The failure of the Imperial raids at Trevissis led to the end the Listehol Campaign, and an Imperial [[Invasion of Tervissis|invasion]] of Tervissis in [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released in [[2012]].<ref name="Warfare" />
